privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.text1: We collect only the information necessary to operate the Cijene platform, such as data you provide when creating an account or interacting with price comparison features. Usage analytics help us understand how the product performs so we can improve reliability and keep the service free.
privacy.text2: Personal information is never sold to third parties. We may share anonymized and aggregated insights with partners for the sole purpose of enhancing grocery price accuracy. Any third-party processors must comply with GDPR and maintain comparable safeguards.
privacy.text3: You can request a copy or deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting us at {email}. We aim to respond to all privacy requests within 30 days.
privacy.text4: Continued use of Cijene indicates acceptance of this Privacy Policy. Significant updates will be communicated through in-product notifications and email when applicable.
terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.text1: By accessing or using Cijene you agree to these Terms. The service is provided on an "as is" basis for informational purposes only. Pricing data is sourced from public and partner feeds and may contain inaccuracies; always verify at the physical store or retailer checkout before purchasing.
terms.text2: You agree not to misuse the platform, attempt to reverse engineer data collection, or disrupt service availability. Accounts found abusing rate limits or automating requests without prior approval may be suspended.
terms.text3: We may update these Terms as the product evolves. Material changes will be announced via email or in-app notification, and continued use after the update constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
terms.text4: These Terms are governed by Croatian law, and disputes will be resolved in the courts of Zagreb unless mutually agreed otherwise.
